summary: Comprehensive testing of GPS Mileage Tracker multi-leg trip system (pause/resume) and TripReplayMap component. Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%) - pause event creates leg with distance, resume event resumes paused trip, multi-leg trip calculates combined distance and stores combined route_geometry, single-leg trip still works correctly, Siri API key authenticates pause/resume events. Frontend: All UI elements verified - green Start Trip header button, amber Pause button when active, Resume/End buttons when paused, Quick Trip section, Siri Shortcuts guide, Manual Entry button, Summary tabs (Today/Month/Year), TripReplayMap with play/pause/speed controls.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend log-drive endpoint correctly handles pause/resume events with leg distance calculation via OSRM
Multi-leg trips store per-leg geometry and combine them into route_geometry on completion
Trip detail endpoint re-fetches route_geometry from OSRM for old trips that don't have it stored
Siri API key authentication works for all events (start/pause/resume/end)
Frontend header buttons correctly show Start Trip (green) when idle, Pause+End (amber+red) when active, Resume+End (green+red) when paused
TripReplayMap component renders with play/pause/speed controls and animated car marker along route
seed_data_creation: Test trips created during backend testing (cleaned up via teardown)
context_for_next_testing_agent: GPS Mileage Tracker multi-leg trip system fully tested. KEY FEATURES: (1) Pause/resume events in log-drive endpoint for multi-stop trips. (2) Each leg calculates distance via OSRM and stores geometry. (3) On trip completion, all leg geometries are combined into route_geometry. (4) TripReplayMap component shows animated car traveling along route with play/pause/speed controls. (5) Header buttons: start-trip-header-btn (green), pause-trip-header-btn (amber), resume-trip-header-btn (green), end-trip-header-btn (red). (6) Expanded section buttons: start-trip-btn, pause-trip-btn, resume-trip-btn, end-trip-btn. (7) Summary tabs: summary-tab-today, summary-tab-month, summary-tab-year. (8) Siri Shortcuts guide: siri-shortcuts-guide. (9) Manual entry: manual-entry-btn. Test coordinates for multi-leg: START(34.0522,-118.2437) -> PAUSE(34.0622,-118.2337) -> RESUME(34.0622,-118.2337) -> END(34.0822,-118.2137).
